name: Memory Enhancements
description: Memory-core companions, mostly observers in v0.1. Live: O(1) anchor → chunk hippocampus index. Scaffolded but log-only: task-conditioned retrieval scoring, contradiction-gate on writes, compaction-aware capture. The compaction-capture hook does NOT delay compaction — it logs which messages would have been dropped. Real persistence + true eviction land in v0.2.

indexDir.description: Where the pre-computed anchor → chunk concept index is stored.

minConceptLength.description: Minimum concept token length to be indexed (shorter tokens are noise).

importanceThreshold.description: Minimum importance score [0,1] for a concept to survive pruning.

taskWeight.description: How strongly current task context biases retrieval scores [0,1].

mode.description: warn: log contradictions but allow the write. block: refuse the write.

compactionCapture.description: v0.1 OBSERVER-ONLY: logs which messages would be dropped on compaction. Does NOT delay compaction and does NOT persist anything yet — those land in v0.2.

captureMode.description: dropped-only: log only messages about to be lost. full-context: log entire context window. v0.1 is log-only either way.
